deferred_checks.reason: The gate-10 boot has no in-guest control channel: the gate-5 Windows image's serial marker was a one-shot first-logon command and the identity control agent belongs to gate 6. Until GUI login driving is wired through the identity lane, Windows evidence is boot-observed only and must never claim login-proven.

Proving the ttyS0 login surface exists does not authenticate a principal. Authenticated Arch login belongs to the gate-8 identity lifecycle; gate 10 only proves the login surface is reachable from a cold menu selection.
